Based on the provided abstract:
- The study synthesized a polyacrylamide-titanium dioxide (PAA@TiO2) nanocomposite using a cross-linking method.
- It investigated the elimination of crystal violet (CV) dye from water using this composite.
- The maximum adsorption capacity found was about 38.9 mg g⁻¹.
- The interaction and molecular mechanisms were investigated using Monte Carlo and molecular dynamics simulations.

Hypothesis 3 matches the material (PAA@TiO2 nanocomposite synthesized via a cross-linking method), the target dye (crystal violet), and the experimentally determined maximum adsorption capacity (38.9 mg/g).

CHOICE: 3
